While testing, this behavior of switching to the mesh library editor when setting the mesh library did not make a lot of sense to me.
Relying on the fallback doesn't work for the gridmap editor. The code for using the mesh preview should probably be duplicated there.

Mystery solved - `set_edited(true)` usually gets called on resources by `UndoRedo`, but somehow `UndoRedo` doesn't touch the mesh library directly, so calling it manually on change fixes the issue.

```suggestion

mesh_library->set_edited(true);
```
Thanks for the heads up!

It doesn't happen when loading it, at least not here.
Then not sure what's the problem.

Considering the usual setup is (right?): create scene for mesh library export -> export mesh library -> create a grid map -> set a mesh library, the expectation is that you see your meshes and are ready to paint, but the assign just switched the bottom panel to the mesh library editor. As far as I can tell this is different from tilemaps.

Not that big of a deal either way, just struck me as odd.
